description: Renovate merges automerge-eligible PRs itself rather than handing them to GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge). Native auto-merge only waits for the checks branch protection marks REQUIRED, so where they aren't marked it merges the moment the PR opens — ahead of CI. With platformAutomerge false, Renovate waits for every check on the branch to be green first. Same setting the shared github>yschimke/renovate-config preset carries; this config predates that preset and inlines config:recommended, so it has to say it itself.

packageRules.description: Ignore kotlinx-datetime *-compat artifacts that keep the legacy 0.6.x API

compose-ai-tools ships the preview CLI, the ee.schimke.composeai Gradle plugin, and the reusable CI composite actions as a single release. Track it aggressively so CI always runs the latest renderer: one grouped PR (so the pinned action refs never skew apart from the catalog plugin pin), no weekly-window wait, and automerge as soon as CI is green — that is the whole point of pinning to a release that moves several times a day. Regenerating the published catalog against the new renderer no longer depends on WHO merges: design-artifacts.yml has a push trigger on main covering the pins this PR touches, so a Renovate merge (app token — raises `push`) republishes on its own, and scheduled-merge.yml still dispatches design-artifacts.yml explicitly for the merges it makes itself (GITHUB_TOKEN merges raise no `push` event).
